id_and_class.summary: Markwell identifies conscious experience with the brain’s ongoing recursive, temporally integrated, embodied self-modeling, a dynamic process comparable to weather. Each conscious moment is a cycle of reintegration across brain networks that folds in bodily, emotional, and hormonal signals and updates the system’s self-model. Because experience simply is this process, he argues that zombies are incoherent and the hard problem reduces to an epistemic gap.
id_and_class.core_identity_tagline: Consciousness as Recursive, Embodied Self-Modeling Dynamics

conceptual_ground.explanatory_identity_claim: Consciousness is identical to the organism’s recursive, temporally integrated, embodied self-model unfolding in ongoing neural dynamics. Experience is the first-person instantiation of those processes, not something they produce.
conceptual_ground.mind_body_relationship: Identity between experience and dynamic neural processes, extending classical mind-brain identity theory from states to processes. Markwell likens it to Spinoza’s monism, with mind and body as two expressions of one physical process.
conceptual_ground.emergence_type: Not applicable (experience is identical with recursive neural dynamics, not produced by them, much as weather is atmospheric dynamics)
conceptual_ground.subjectivity_and_intentionality: Recursive self-representation generates an internal point of view, following Hofstadter’s strange loop. The subject, which Markwell calls ‘the Reader,’ is the system’s continuously updated self-model, not a homunculus.
conceptual_ground.qualia_account: Qualia are embodied integrated states. Colors, pains, and emotions arise when perceptions merge with interoceptive, hormonal, and visceral signals into gestalt packages that are fed back into each cycle of the loop.
conceptual_ground.ontological_commitments: Neural networks (default mode, salience, executive), recurrent cortical and subcortical loops, interoceptive and homeostatic signals, neurotransmitters and hormones, and the self-model they jointly constitute.
conceptual_ground.epistemic_access: Through neuroscience of recurrent processing, timing, and brain networks, combined with first-person experience, which is the process instantiated from the inside.
conceptual_ground.constituents_and_structure: A ‘newsroom’ loop: Reporters (new sensory input), Background knowledge (default mode network), Editors (salience and executive networks), the Action Desk (threshold-based action), and the Wire Service (global coherence), returning to the Reader as an updated self-model.

mechanism_and_dynamics.scope_of_consciousness: Phenomenal (qualia as embodied integrated states); self-awareness; temporal continuity and unity; action selection
mechanism_and_dynamics.distinctive_mechanism_or_principle: Recursive self-modeling across roughly 200 to 300 millisecond windows of integration, in which predictions are compared with incoming signals and the self-model is updated each cycle.
mechanism_and_dynamics.dynamics_of_emergence: Consciousness is a continuous process. Each moment corresponds to a cycle of neural reintegration, echoing William James’s specious present, and each iteration produces a new ‘edition’ of the self.
mechanism_and_dynamics.location_and_distribution: Distributed across cortical and subcortical networks, including the default mode, salience, and executive networks, and coupled to the body through interoceptive loops.
mechanism_and_dynamics.causation_and_functional_role: The loop prioritizes what matters, allocates cognitive resources, and drives action through a threshold-based interface. Rapid awareness of the affective weight of experience likely evolved for efficiency.
mechanism_and_dynamics.integration_or_binding: Reentrant dynamics integrate perception, memory, and action, and global coherence (the ‘Wire Service’) stabilizes each conscious moment, supporting unity and selfhood.
mechanism_and_dynamics.information_flow_or_representation: Predictive processing at several levels compares predictions with inputs and reshapes internal attractor states. All represented content unfolds within the self-model.
mechanism_and_dynamics.evolutionary_account: Near-instant awareness of the affective weight of experience likely arose because it is efficient under environmental and internal constraints.
core_claims_and_evidence: Conscious perception integrates information over roughly 200 to 300 milliseconds, reflected in recurrent cortical activity and event-related potentials.
Perception is inseparable from bodily state because neural loops incorporate interoceptive, emotional, and homeostatic signals.
A physically identical organism would instantiate the same processes, so a zombie lacking experience is incoherent.
The gap between mechanism and phenomenology is epistemic, since knowing every third-person description of a process differs from instantiating it.
mechanism_and_dynamics.basis_of_belief_or_evidence_type: Theoretical synthesis of neuroscience findings with philosophical argument

empirics_and_critiques.criticisms_and_tensions: Markwell anticipates Dennett’s Cartesian Theater objection to placing a ‘reader’ at the start and end of the loop, and answers that the reader is only the current self-model. His treatment of the hard problem rests on the claim that explanatory identity bottoms out, which anti-physicalists dispute.
empirics_and_critiques.open_questions_and_limitations: The theory is a synthesis of existing findings and does not specify experiments that would distinguish it from neighbouring self-model and predictive-processing theories.
empirics_and_critiques.ontological_coherence: Consistent with physicalist monism. Markwell reports that it converges with O’Reilly-Shah’s State Space Theory, developed independently from bottom-up principles.

AI_consciousness.rationale: It follows from the identity claim that a system would be conscious only if it instantiated recursive, temporally integrated self-modeling grounded in bodily regulation, which current AI lacks.

survival_beyond_death.rationale: Since experience is identical to ongoing neural and bodily processes, it follows that experience stops when those processes stop.

meaning_and_purpose.rationale: Consciousness is the internal perspective of a living recursive system, with no cosmic purpose implied.

virtual_immortality.rationale: Markwell stresses embodied hormonal and visceral signals, and it is unclear whether a simulation without a body would instantiate the same process.
